name: Never Coming Back
summary: Va'xug Firefure is trapped in an Ashenvale ravine and asks you to thin the nearby wildlife. The forest's confusing paths and the volatility of Va'xug's spells have left them angry.

sections.title: A Forest Snare
sections.body: Va'xug Firefure is gathering herbs in Ashenvale when the forest's paths leave them trapped in a ravine. They say their spells grow volatile when they are angry, and the nearby beasts only worsen their temper. Va'xug asks you to thin the wildlife around them.

sections.title: A Calmer Mood
sections.body: Va'xug Firefure thanks you after the nearby wildlife has been thinned. They say it seems to have helped, though their anger at the forest remains plain.

faq.answer: Va'xug Firefure is gathering herbs in Ashenvale when they become trapped in a ravine.
Va'xug is angry because Ashenvale's paths have left them trapped in a ravine, and the nearby beasts grate on them.

faq.q: What does Va'xug ask me to do?
faq.answer: Va'xug asks you to thin the nearby wildlife.
Va'xug says their spells grow volatile and behave differently when they are angry.

attribution: In-game quest text: Never Coming Back
